import unittest

from solution import decode_envelope


class DecodeEnvelopeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_document_and_output_order(self):
        result = decode_envelope('  {"values": [1, -2, 0], "token": "abc"}\n\t')
        self.assertEqual(result, {"token": "abc", "values": [1, -2, 0]})
        self.assertEqual(list(result), ["token", "values"])

    def test_trailing_non_whitespace_is_rejected(self):
        for text in (
            '{"token":"x","values":[]} trailing',
            '{"token":"x","values":[]}{}',
            '{"token":"x","values":[]} null',
        ):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_envelope(text)

    def test_empty_and_malformed_json(self):
        for text in ("", "   \n\t", "{", '{"token": "x",}', "not-json"):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_envelope(text)

    def test_top_level_and_schema_validation(self):
        for text in ("null", "[]", '"text"', "1"):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    decode_envelope(text)
        for text in (
            '{"token":"x"}',
            '{"values":[]}',
            '{"token":"x","values":[],"extra":1}',
        ):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    decode_envelope(text)

    def test_field_validation(self):
        for text in (
            '{"token":1,"values":[]}',
            '{"token":null,"values":[]}',
            '{"token":"x","values":{}}',
            '{"token":"x","values":[true]}',
            '{"token":"x","values":[1.0]}',
            '{"token":"x","values":["1"]}',
        ):
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    decode_envelope(text)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            decode_envelope('{"token":"","values":[]}')

    def test_non_string_input(self):
        for value in (None, b"{}", {}, []):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    decode_envelope(value)

    def test_calls_do_not_share_mutable_state(self):
        text = '{"token":"x","values":[1]}'
        first = decode_envelope(text)
        second = decode_envelope(text)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first["values"], second["values"])
        first["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(second, {"token": "x", "values": [1]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
